about.title: About Us
about.story_p1: Welcome to Costaspressjr, where creativity meets quality. Founded with a passion for self-expression through fashion, we've been helping people wear their personality since day one.
about.story_p2: We believe that a t-shirt is more than just clothing – it's a canvas for your identity. Whether you're looking for a bold statement piece, a subtle classic, or a completely custom design, we've got you covered.
about.mission_lead: To provide high-quality, comfortable, and unique t-shirts that help our customers express themselves. We're committed to:
about.mission_item2: Offering fair prices without compromising quality
about.quality_lead: Every t-shirt we sell goes through rigorous quality checks. We use only the finest cotton blends to ensure comfort, durability, and a perfect fit that lasts wash after wash.

info.faq.title: FAQ
info.faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the things people ask most.
info.faq.a1: Most orders are printed and shipped within 3–5 business days. Large orders or complex custom designs may take longer — you'll see an estimate at checkout.
info.faq.q2: Can I change or cancel an order after placing it?
info.faq.a2: If your order hasn't entered production yet, contact us immediately via the Contact page and we'll try to help. Once production starts we can no longer make changes.
info.faq.q3: What file types can I upload?
info.faq.a3: PNG, JPEG, and WebP are supported. For the sharpest print, upload at least 300 DPI at the size you want it printed.
info.faq.q4: Do you print copyrighted or trademarked content?
info.faq.a4: No. You must own or have a licence to use any design you upload. Orders containing infringing or offensive artwork will be cancelled and refunded.
info.faq.q5: What if my item arrives damaged or misprinted?
info.faq.a5: Reach out via the Contact page within 14 days of delivery with photos. We'll replace the item or refund you, depending on the situation. See Returns.
info.faq.a6: Yes — available countries and shipping fees are shown at checkout.
info.faq.q7: How do I track my order?
info.faq.a7: Log in and go to My Account › Orders for the latest status. If shipping info is available you'll see a tracking link there.
info.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
info.cookies.subtitle: What cookies we set, why, and how to control them.
info.cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device. Costaspressjr uses them to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and understand how the site is used.
info.cookies.essential_lead: These are required for the site to work. They cannot be disabled:
info.cookies.essential_phpsessid: PHPSESSID — keeps you signed in and remembers your session.
info.cookies.essential_csrf: A CSRF token stored in your session, used to protect form submissions against cross-site request forgery.
info.cookies.preference_lead: Set only after you accept the cookie banner. Used to remember your choices (such as cookie preferences) so you are not re-prompted on every visit.
info.cookies.analytics_lead: We currently do not use third-party analytics or advertising cookies. If this changes we will update this policy and ask for your consent before setting any.
info.cookies.managing_lead: You can block or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will prevent sign-in and checkout from working.
info.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
info.privacy.subtitle: What we collect, how we use it, and the controls you have.
info.privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Costaspressjr collects when you use our site and how we handle it.
info.privacy.account_data: Account data — your username, email, phone number (optional), and hashed password.
info.privacy.order_data: Order data — billing and shipping addresses, order contents, and payment metadata (card brand and last four digits — we never store full card numbers).
info.privacy.designs: Designs you upload — images and text you submit for printing.
info.privacy.usage: Usage data — IP address, browser type, and pages visited, used to keep the site running and to detect abuse.
info.privacy.p2: We use your information to fulfil your orders, operate the site, communicate with you about your purchases, and comply with our legal obligations.
info.privacy.p3: We share only what is necessary with payment processors, shipping carriers, and hosting providers. We do not sell your personal information.
info.privacy.p4: We use cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. See our Cookie Policy for details.
info.privacy.p5: We keep your account and order records for as long as your account is active, and for a limited period afterwards to meet legal and accounting obligations.
info.privacy.p6: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete the personal data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, contact us via the Contact page.
info.privacy.p7: We store passwords hashed, use HTTPS in production, and limit internal access to your data. No system is perfectly secure, so we encourage you to use a strong, unique password.
info.privacy.p8: Reach us through the Contact page for any privacy-related question or request.
info.privacy.placeholder: Placeholder notice: if you sell to customers in the EU, UK, or California, have this policy reviewed for GDPR / UK-GDPR / CCPA compliance before launch.
info.terms.title: Terms of Service
info.terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and Costaspressjr when using this site.
info.terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Costaspressjr website and services (the "Service"). By creating an account, placing an order, or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
info.terms.p1: You must provide accurate information when registering and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
info.terms.p2: All orders are subject to availability and acceptance. Prices and product details are shown in your local currency where supported and include applicable taxes where required. Payment is charged at the time of purchase.
info.terms.p3: You retain ownership of any artwork you upload. By submitting a design you confirm that you have the right to use it and grant Costaspressjr a limited licence to reproduce it for the purpose of fulfilling your order. We may refuse to print content that is unlawful, infringing, or offensive.
info.terms.p4: Shipping times and fees are shown at checkout. Delivery estimates are not guarantees. Risk of loss passes to you on delivery.
info.terms.p5: Custom items are made to order and may not be eligible for return unless defective. See our Returns page for full details.
info.terms.p6: The Costaspressjr name, logo, and site content (excluding user-submitted designs) are the property of Costaspressjr. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute site content without permission.
info.terms.p7: To the extent permitted by law, Costaspressjr is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the order giving rise to the claim.
info.terms.p8: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance.
info.terms.p9: Questions about these Terms can be sent via our Contact page.

info.shipping.title: Shipping Info
info.shipping.subtitle: Delivery times, costs, and how we get your order to you.
info.shipping.p1: We print everything to order. Most items ship within 3–5 business days. Larger orders or complex custom designs may take a little longer.
info.shipping.p2_lead: Once your order ships, typical delivery windows are:
info.shipping.p2_after: These are estimates — actual delivery times depend on your location and the carrier.
info.shipping.p3: Fees are calculated at checkout based on destination, weight, and the service you choose. Free standard shipping applies to orders over the threshold shown on your cart.
info.shipping.p4: As soon as your order ships you'll receive a confirmation with tracking details. You can also check status at My Account.
info.shipping.p5: International orders may be subject to customs duties or import taxes in the destination country. These are your responsibility and are not included in the order total.
info.shipping.placeholder: Placeholder notice: update the exact rates, thresholds, and carriers before launch.
info.returns.title: Returns
info.returns.subtitle: Our policy for items that arrive damaged, defective, or not as described.
info.returns.p1: Because every product is printed to order, we don't accept returns for reasons like "changed my mind" or ordering the wrong size. Please check the Size Guide before ordering.
info.returns.p2: If your item arrives damaged, defective, or is materially different from what you ordered, contact us within 14 days of delivery via the Contact page. Include your order number and clear photos showing the issue. We'll replace the item or refund you at no additional cost.
info.returns.p3: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. It may take 5–10 business days for the refund to appear, depending on your bank or card issuer.
info.returns.p4_a: Normal wear and tear after use.
info.returns.p4_b: Damage caused by incorrect washing or care. Follow the care label.
info.returns.p4_c: Custom designs that were proofed and approved by you but contain a typo or artwork error.
info.returns.placeholder: Placeholder notice: adjust this to match the consumer protection laws of the regions you sell in.
info.sizing.title: Size Guide
info.sizing.subtitle: How to pick the right fit — measured in centimetres.
info.sizing.p1: Take measurements over your natural body line, not on top of clothing. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
info.sizing.chest: Chest: around the fullest part, under the arms.
info.sizing.waist: Waist: around your natural waistline, above the hip bone.
info.sizing.length: Length: from the top of the shoulder down to where you want the hem.
info.sizing.placeholder: Placeholder notice: replace these figures with the actual dimensions from your supplier's spec sheet before launch.
info.track.title: Track Order
info.track.subtitle: Check the status of a recent purchase.
info.track.signed_in: The fastest way to track an order is from your account dashboard.
info.track.guest_intro: Order tracking is available from your account dashboard.
info.track.guest_lead: Please sign in to see the status of recent orders. If you don't have an account yet, create one using the same email used at checkout.
info.track.p2: Once your order ships you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can follow the package directly on the carrier's website using that number.
info.track.p3: Reach out via the Contact page with your order number and we'll look into it.
